snippet.title: GODBREAKERS | OFFICIAL RELEASE DATE TRAILER | PC & PS5
snippet.description:
Absorb enemy powers and unleash godlike co-op combat!💥 Godbreakers is coming October 23, 2025 to Steam, PS5, and Epic Games Store! 💥Wishlist now:
Steam https://store.steampowered.com/app/2687400/GODBREAKERS/
PS5: https://store.playstation.com/concept/10010891/
Epic Games Store: https://store.epicgames.com/p/godbreakers-dbc2e9

In Godbreakers, take control of every fight with ferociously fluid combat as you chain aggressive combos, cancel moves mid-swing, and steal enemy powers to turn them against their masters. Play in up to 4-player co-op to craft the perfect team setup and topple brutal bosses across different worlds. #GODBREAKERS 

Godbreakers is part of Steam Next Fest (Oct 13-20, 2025) with an expanded demo featuring a new biome, challenges, cosmetics, and more! Don't miss out!

Join the Godbreakers Community on Discord: 
https://discord.com/invite/dkPKceAgK3

Follow us on Socials:
X: https://x.com/GODBREAKERS
Bsky: https://bsky.app/profile/godbreakers.bsky.social
Instagram: https://instagram.com/godbreakers
Tiktok: https://www.tiktok.com/@godbreakers_game
